user.title: State Grid - Account sign-in
user.description:
The App channel is tried first (no captcha, no LLM configuration needed).

{fallback_hint}

data_description.llm_api_key: Only needed for the web sign-in fallback, used to solve captchas
data_description.llm_model: Model ID (e.g. doubao-seed-2-0-pro-260215); only needed for the web sign-in fallback

error.missing_llm_key: The App channel did not sign in, so the web fallback needs an LLM API key (captcha solving)
error.missing_llm_model: The App channel did not sign in, so the web fallback needs an LLM model ID (captcha solving)
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the State Grid servers
error.rk001_rate_limit: Daily sign-in quota exhausted (RK001 rate limit). Try again after 00:00

abort.single_instance_allowed: A State Grid instance already exists. Remove it before adding another

init.title: State Grid - Options
init.description: Change the LLM configuration (web fallback only), the backup e-mail and the refresh interval. Leave a field empty to keep the current value. To update the State Grid password, fill in the "new password" field - it is verified once on submit.

data.new_password: New password (empty keeps current; filling it triggers one sign-in attempt)

data_description.llm_model: Model ID (e.g. doubao-seed-2-0-pro-260215); leave empty to use only the App channel

error.invalid_auth: The new password was rejected. Check the password
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the State Grid servers
error.no_account: No running integration instance found. Try again or restart Home Assistant
error.rk001_cooldown_cannot_verify: Currently inside the RK001 cooldown, so the new password cannot be verified. Try again after 00:00
error.rk001_rate_limit: Daily sign-in quota exhausted (RK001 rate limit). Try again after 00:00
